name: Show3D - Interactive 3D Science Learning Platform
description: Free, no-registration-required browser-based 3D science education platform with interactive model viewing, format conversion, and optimization
coreFeatures: Interactive 3D Viewer - Rotate, zoom, pan controls with Hollywood red carpet presentation mode
Intelligent Caching - LRU cache and preloading system for sub-3-second model loading
Built-in Format Converter - Convert OBJ/FBX/STL and more to optimized GLB format
Professional Model Optimizer - DRACO compression achieving 50-80% file size reduction
Rich Educational Metadata - Fun facts, test point markers, microscope visibility info
